verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a SaaS data-pipeline platform that could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in assistant. What it does document is an MCP server that lets external AI agents manage the pipeline; that is a separate capability (serving tools to outside agents) and earns no credit for a built-in assistant users delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
